52210.author: perrotta
52210.body:
Add EGamma regression tags (temporarily the ones from 2025) to allow HIN EGamma regression also in the 2026 HI MC workflows, as needed after the error reported in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51989#issuecomment-6170247996 and requested in [cmsTalk](https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/request-of-new-mc-gt-for-131x-141x-and-151x/148065/12)

The new HI 2026 MC GT in autoCond is now [161X_mcRun3_2026_realistic_HI_v5](https://cms-conddb.cern.ch/cmsDbBrowser/list/Prod/gts/161X_mcRun3_2026_realistic_HI_v5) and the diff wrt previous such GT in autoCond (_v4) is [here](https://cms-conddb.cern.ch/cmsDbBrowser/diff/Prod/gts/161X_mcRun3_2026_realistic_HI_v4/161X_mcRun3_2026_realistic_HI_v5)

#### PR validation:

Tested in CMSSW_17_0_X, also with the HLT test which was previously failing there.
Not strictly neecessary now for Phase2 releases (at lest not until the EGamma regression of #51989 is ported in 20_0_X/21_0_X: till then this modification is completely transparent to all workflows), but for consistency with the other HI MC GTs in autoCond for the Phase2 cmssw cycles I would still merge this update.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Forward port of #52205
52210.title: Add 2025 EG regression tags as placeholders for the 2026 HI MC GT in autoCond [20_0_X]
